column3: NASB supplies “as wives”; “the offspring of holiness” is rendered “the holy race,” “officials” as “rulers,” and “first” as “foremost.”
“Humiliated” is rendered “embarrassed,” and “increased upward a head” as “risen above our heads.”
“Covenant loyalty” is rendered “lovingkindness,” and “set up its ruins” as “restore its ruins.”
“From mouth to mouth” is rendered “from end to end.”
“Their good” is rendered “their prosperity,” and “cause to inherit” as “leave it as an inheritance.”
“Withheld downwards from our iniquity” is rendered “requited us less than our iniquities deserve.”
“Until to make an end” is rendered “to the point of destruction.”
“Not to stand” is rendered “no one can stand.”
